## Runs 6 + 7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): electron n = +3.2×10¹², hole n = −1.2×10¹²

Raw Rxx(B) first (row 1), then the B-space-background-removed trace vs 1/B, and 1/B FFTs over nested windows against F_L (= the ABCA singleton) and the model's ABAB pair. Onsets from `sdh_onset` on the Nyquist-clean part of each record — run 6 below 1 T was stepped at 50 mT, which undersamples a 7 T tone, so its onset analysis starts at 1.0 T.

**Electron side (run 6, F_L = 33.1 T):** a low-B tone at **7.3 T** (SNR 96, still above threshold at 1.0 T, so the onset is below the record edge and not measured), a tone at **22.3 T** (onset 1.40 T), and a strong tone at **29.4 T** (onset 1.76 T) that takes over the spectrum above ~3 T, plus a comb above 40 T that turns on at 3–6 T (QH-regime harmonics). The model's ABAB pair here is 7.3 / 25.8 T. The light tone lands on the model exactly; the 22.3 T tone is 14 % under the heavy branch. 7.3 + 22.3 = 29.6 T ≈ the 29.4 T high-B tone ≈ 0.89 F_L. A single density can't separate three readings of the 29.4 T tone: a breakdown/total-ladder sum tone, the 4th harmonic of 7.3 T, or an ABCA singleton read at a 0.89 lever-arm scale. Each tracks a different slope in n (sum: dF_L/dn; 4× light: 4·dF_light/dn; singleton: F_L). **Hole side (run 7, F_L = 12.4 T):** low-B tones at 3.5 / 4.6 / 6.8 T (6.8 T onset ≤ 0.5 T, censored), and at high B a tone at **12.3 T ≈ F_L** (onset 1.73 T). This is the near-CNP semimetal regime, where the model's ABAB pair is close and balanced (5.9 / 6.5 T) and ABCA is LK-dead (m* ≈ 1.1 mₑ). **Read:** both sides show low-B structure below F_L with an F_L-scale tone that switches on at higher B. That fits ABAB-plus-breakdown **(consistent-with)**, but it is not a call: one density per side can't separate the sum tone from a harmonic or a singleton, and only the electron side reaches the densities where the templates separate. **Next:** the electron-side D = 0 fan (tracking F(n) across 2.0–3.25×10¹² is the partition-robustness and branch-labeling test), after a cheap low-field extension pins the censored light-tone onset.

# Runs 6 + 7 — sdh-spot-check, electron (n = +3.2e12) and hole (n = -1.2e12) at D = 0. Raw first, then onset + FFT vs F_L and the model.
import sys, warnings
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.home() / "measurement_env" / "hera" / "models" / "tetralayer_fs_count"))
import fs_count_b0 as fsm

def spot(rid):
    r = run(rid); B = r.col("magnet_field"); R = r.col("sr1_X") / (r.col("sr0_X") / -1e6)   # R = (sr1_X/1)/(sr0_X/-1e6)
    o = np.argsort(B); return r, B[o], R[o]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(13, 11))
for k, (rid, n12, b_lo, wins) in enumerate([(6, +3.2, 1.0, [(1.0, 10), (1.5, 10), (2.5, 10), (4.0, 10)]),
                                            (7, -1.2, 0.5, [(0.5, 10), (1.0, 10), (2.0, 10), (3.0, 10)])]):
    r, B, R = spot(rid)
    FL = float(luttinger_frequency(n12 * 1e16)); ab = fsm.abab_fs(n12 * 1e16)[1]; ca = fsm.abca_fs(n12 * 1e16)[4]
    print(f"run {rid}: n = {n12:+}e12, D = 0 | B {B.min():.2f}-{B.max():.2f} T, {len(B)} pts | R {R.min():.0f}..{R.max():.0f} Ohm | "
          f"T {r.col('T_sample').min():.3f}-{r.col('T_sample').max():.3f} K | F_L = {FL:.1f} T; model ABAB {[round(f, 1) for f, _ in ab]} T, ABCA {ca:.1f} T")
    ax[0, k].plot(B, R, lw=0.7); ax[0, k].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx B_1-B_2 (Ohm)", title=f"run {rid} raw, n = {n12:+}e12, D = 0")
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always"); on = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=b_lo, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9)
    print(on.summary()); [print("  note:", str(x.message)[:160]) for x in w]
    m = B >= wins[1][0]; dR = R[m] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[m], R[m], 5), B[m])
    ax[1, k].plot(1 / B[m], dR, lw=0.7); ax[1, k].set(xlabel="1/B (1/T)", ylabel="dR (Ohm)", title=f"deg-5 B-space background removed, B > {wins[1][0]} T")
    for lo, hi in wins:
        f, sp = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(lo, hi), bg_degree=5, nfft=4096, log=False); s = sp[0] / sp[0].max()
        pk = [i for i in range(1, len(s) - 1) if s[i] > s[i - 1] and s[i] > s[i + 1] and s[i] > 0.12 and f[i] > 1.5]
        print(f"  FFT B {lo}-{hi} T (dF = {1/(1/lo-1/hi):.2f} T): " + ", ".join(f"{f[i]:.1f} ({s[i]:.2f})" for i in pk[:8]))
        ax[2, k].plot(f, s, lw=0.8, label=f"B {lo}-{hi} T")
    ax[2, k].axvline(FL, color="k", ls="--", label="F_L")
    for fa, _ in ab: ax[2, k].axvline(fa, color="C3", ls=":", lw=1)
    ax[2, k].set(xlim=(0, 2.2 * FL), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="|FFT| (norm.)", title="FFT in 1/B (red dotted: model ABAB pair; black: F_L = ABCA)"); ax[2, k].legend(fontsize=7)
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 3c: low-field extension at n = +2.0×10¹² (`sdh-spot-check`), B 1.5 → 0.3 T, the step before the fan

> **05:27** · sdh-spot-check low-B extension: n=+2.0e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.640, Vbg +0.721), B 1.5->0.3 T uniform-1/B 168 pts, d(1/B) 0.016, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends 0.3 T · **ETA ~05:57** (≈30 min)

The operator asked for the stacking fan. This ~30 min cell runs first because the fan's cheapest lever (`landau-fan` step 1, lever 1: B_lo = the measured onset from `sdh_onset`) is currently unmeasured. The electron light tone (7.3 T at n = +3.2, runs 6/ana) is **censored**: it is still above threshold at 1.0 T, the lowest field run 6 sampled cleanly (its 50 mT steps below 1 T undersample a 7 T tone). The recipe says to pin a censored onset with a cheap low-field extension before a multi-hour fan. The light tone is the one ABCA lacks, so it carries the stacking read, and it binds at the fan's **low-density edge**: at n = 2.0 the model puts it at 3.55 T, and 5 periods before 10 T need B_lo ≤ 0.66 T. So the extension sits at **n = +2.0, D = 0** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.640, +0.721) V. That is also the fan's first column, so the gates don't move between the two cells. It also gives a third density point for the light branch (model 3.55 T here vs 7.31 T at 3.2), an early look at the n-dependence.

**Grid:** uniform in 1/B, 1.5 → 0.3 T descending, 168 pts, Δ(1/B) = 0.016 = 1/(3·F_L(2.0)); delay 0, since the blocking set plus the 3 s magnet settle gives 10 τ (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct). It ends at 0.3 T, below the fan's start, so the fan begins on an ascending branch. **Sensitivity:** 50 µV (5 kΩ FS, the spot-check scale; state0 left `sr1` at 2 µV). **Guards:** interrupt on a gate current > 1 nA or T > 1.8 K. **Fan design (lands on this read):** electron side, D = 0, n 2.0 → 3.25×10¹² (51 columns, Δn = 0.025), B from B_lo (this read) → 10 T. The field axis is uniform in 1/B at Δ(1/B) = 0.0099 = 1/(3·F_L(3.25)), capped at ΔB = 0.1 T above 3.2 T so the QH-regime harmonics of run 6 stay Nyquist-sampled. fast_delay 1.2 s. At B_lo = 0.5 T it prices at ≈ 6.7 h. **Coverage trade:** the hole side is excluded from the fan. Its D = 0 reach stops at −1.27×10¹² (TG limit), entirely inside the near-CNP regime where the templates don't separate (run 7). **Checkpoint:** read the record from disk at the end: `sdh_onset` gives the light-tone onset, which fixes B_lo, n_lo, and the fan's price.

# === Low-field extension (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +2.0e12, D = 0, B 1.5 -> 0.3 T uniform in 1/B — pins the light-tone onset for the fan's B_lo ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
from qcodes import Parameter

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_spot, D_spot = 2.0, 0.0                       # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm — the fan's low-density (binding) column
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.02: handoff left 0 T), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"V_tg/V_bg = {k_tg.volt():+.3f}/{k_bg.volt():+.3f} (0/0), nplci {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, heater ranges {heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.02 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert abs(k_tg.volt()) < 0.01 and abs(k_bg.volt()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0
_tau, _slope = sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f"sr1 tau {_tau} s, slope {_slope} dB/oct (expect 0.3 / 24: the 3 s magnet settle = 10 tau is the dwell)")
assert _tau == 0.3 and _slope == 24

# --- field grid: uniform in 1/B, descending 1.5 -> 0.3 T. Nyquist: F_L(2.0e12) = 20.7 T -> d(1/B) <= 1/(3 F_L) = 0.0161
B_vec = field_invB(1.5, 0.3, 168)
d_invB = abs(np.diff(1 / B_vec)).max()
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and d_invB <= 1 / (3 * 20.7) + 1e-6
I_TRIP, T_TRIP = 1e-9, 1.8
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)   # 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA — spot-check scale (runs 6/7); state0 restore left it at 2 uV
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, d(1/B) = {d_invB:.4f} 1/T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V; settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s")

# measured field (FastBi readback = output current x T_per_A; the slow column records the setpoint)
if "B_meas" not in globals():
    B_meas = Parameter("B_meas", label="B readback", unit="T", get_cmd=magnet.field.get)

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"sdh-spot-check low-field extension: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = 0 (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), "
                  f"B 1.5 -> 0.3 T uniform-1/B 168 pts, sr1 50 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'low-field extension for the landau-fan B_lo: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = 0; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 1.5 -> 0.3 T uniform in 1/B (168 pts, d(1/B) = {d_invB:.4f}); cal run 5: ratio 0.773, n_offset -0.089e12, D_offset -0.013')

# positioning: magnet 0 -> 1.5 T (blocking, ~11 min bare), then gates to the spot
magnet.field(B_vec[0])
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(set), T_sample, B_meas, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(B_meas).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.P); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample); s.plot(magnet.field, B_meas)

def guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg, T = abs(float(data[4])), abs(float(data[5])), float(data[2])
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP or T > T_TRIP:
        print(f"GUARD TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A, T={T:.3f} K")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at n = 2.0 (the fan's first column); field ends at 0.3 T, below the fan's start — no park.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
